names.note: Read out of saint.gr's notice for 28 Οκτωβρίου, «Η οσία Λαϊόβα ήταν ανιψιά του αγίου Βονιφατίου», with the rank word left off. The day's own line writes her in Latin letters, «Αγία Lioba», and that Latin form is not entered as a name here because it is the page's heading and not a recorded form in a language this corpus holds.

death.note: saint.gr's heading for her, «Αγια Lioba (; - 782)», and in the notice «Η Οσία Λαϊοβα κοιμήθηκε το 782 μ.Χ.». No year of birth is given.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Οκτωβρίου — «Αγία Lioba»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. She is identified by her kinship: the niece of Boniface, whom the same calendar keeps on 5 June and whose folder the corpus already has. The corpus holds no folder of this name, and the namesweep's nearest rows — Leo of Optina, Livia, Olympia of Lesvos — are none of them hers. No location, because the page names Germany and the monastery of Wimborne but no place of her own. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
